text:
kari: FYI PR #4899 adds the migration guide for the client.auth rename + new SDK snippets (python + ts). Need reviews and we want this to land before the doc cutoff for v1.8. Preview: https://docs-preview.redwood.dev/pull/4899

oscar: pinging reviewers. I'll do a quick pass after lunch.

maya: quick heads-up: the preview link shows a broken internal link to /stable/auth; should point to /v1.8/auth or the migration page. docs-bot shows failing link-checks.

kari: noted. I deliberately left the wording defensive since the feature is behind the flag auth-v1. Wondering whether to merge with a banner or wait until the flag flips. thoughts?

tony: Ops perspective: merge before cutoff if docs need to be in the release bundle. If it's feature-gated, we can merge but must add a prominent banner naming the feature flag and rollout window. Also coordinate with release@ for pinning.

release-bot: Reminder: docs cutoff for v1.8 is 2025-05-15T23:59:00Z. To appear in release artifacts, merge before cutoff and include doc commit hash in release notes.

docs-bot: Preview failed: link-checker errors: /sdk/ts/auth.md -> /stable/auth (404), /migration/auth-migration.md -> /v1.8#examples (broken anchor).

kari: fixing links and anchors now; will also add banner: "Note: The instructions below refer to functionality gated by feature flag 'auth-v1'."

oscar: small code nit: python example still shows Client().auth.login(); new API is AuthClient.login(). Also add explicit imports and code fence language.

maya: legal request: remove phrase "military-grade encryption" from examples. Replace with "encrypted in transit and at rest".

kari: pushed patch 4899.2 with link fixes, snippet updates, and wording change. Retrying preview.

docs-bot: Preview succeeded with warnings: missing feature-flag notice in heading. Please surface flag name at top of page.

kari: added a short inline banner at top and updated migration note. Also left a toggle comment that we can flip the visible route to canary.

oscar: LGTM for content. One markdown heading level tweak but not blocking.

maya: legal ok.

sre-oncall: We can support a canary docs rollout. Proposal: (1) merge with banner, (2) publish to /canary/docs/auth and route 5% of traffic, (3) watch link telemetry and error logs for 24h, (4) promote to stable when green. We'll coordinate the ff flip with release.

tony: release ops: if this needs to be in the release tarball, merge no later than 2025-05-14 18:00 UTC so we can cut RCs. Otherwise we can reference /v1.8 in release notes after GA.

kari: decision: we'll merge after SRE confirms canary route is ready and CI is green. Target merge window: 2025-05-14 17:30 UTC to give release team time. I'll post here once merged. Thanks everyone! :raised_hands:

oscar: ack.

maya: merging blockers cleared on my side.

kari: final note: if we see customer confusion after the flag flip, we'll add a troubleshooting snippet and a short example confirming feature status via the API.

release-bot: Noted. Please include doc commit hash when tagging the release.
